title: Privacy Policy
content:
Privacy Policy

Effective Date: March 1, 2026  |  Version: 2026.03.01

RPcore Developer establishes and discloses the following Privacy Policy to protect users' personal information in accordance with the Personal Information Protection Act and relevant laws.

Article 1 (Purpose of Personal Information Processing)
RPcore processes personal information for the following purposes:
① Service registration and management
② AI content generation and personalization
③ Community function provision
④ Service improvement and new feature development
⑤ Legal compliance and dispute resolution

Article 2 (Items of Personal Information Processed)
① Required items: Email address, nickname, device information
② Optional items: Profile image, date of birth, gender
③ Automatically collected items: Service usage records, access logs, cookie information

Article 3 (Processing and Retention Period of Personal Information)
① Personal information is retained and used while users use the Service.
② Immediately destroyed when users request withdrawal.
③ Certain information may be retained for a specific period according to relevant laws.

Article 4 (Provision of Personal Information to Third Parties)
RPcore does not provide users' personal information to third parties in principle.
However, exceptions are made in the following cases:
① When users have consented
② When required by laws
③ When entrusting processing within the minimum scope necessary for service provision

Article 5 (Destruction Procedure for Personal Information)
① Immediately destroyed when users withdraw or the retention period expires.
② Destruction method: Electronic files are deleted irrecoverably, printed materials are shredded.

Article 6 (User Rights)
① Users can inquire, modify, or delete their personal information at any time.
② Can withdraw consent to personal information processing.
③ Have the right to receive information about personal information processing.

Article 7 (Personal Information Protection Measures)
① Technical protection measures: Encryption, access control, firewalls, etc.
② Administrative protection measures: Regular education, internal controls, access record management
③ Physical protection measures: Access control, security facilities

Article 8 (Entrustment of Personal Information Processing)
RPcore entrusts personal information processing as follows for smooth service provision:
① Cloud service providers
② AI model providers
③ Payment agents (when applicable)

Article 9 (Exercise of Data Subject Rights)
① Direct processing through service settings menu
② Inquiry to customer service (fdje0303@gmail.com)
③ Report to relevant agencies such as Personal Information Protection Commission

Article 10 (Personal Information Protection Officer)
① Responsible person: RPcore Developer
② Contact: fdje0303@gmail.com
③ For personal information protection related inquiries, please contact the above.

Article 11 (Remedy for Rights Infringement)
① In case of rights infringement related to personal information, can report to Personal Information Protection Commission.
② Can receive remedies according to the Personal Information Protection Act.

Supplementary Provisions
This Privacy Policy shall take effect from March 1, 2026.
